slides.text:
The three inputs behind
today's session

1 — Last night

Sleep length and depth
set the ceiling

2 — Yesterday's work

Hard legs yesterday means
no hard legs today

3 — This morning's signals

HRV against your own baseline
not a stranger's

Three inputs, one decision

That's what a plan is

slides.heading: One decision, every morning
slides.body: SOMA weighs your night, your training load and your morning signals — and hands you the session, decided
